title: cymbalaria microcalyx subsp. minor
intro: Cymbalaria microcalyx subsp. minor, commonly known as the small-leaved toadflax or small toadflax, is a plant species within the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cymbalaria microcalyx subsp. minor include its ability to soothe coughs, reduce congestion, and ease respiratory discomfort. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
